about.title: The Maestro Story
about.paragraph1: At Maestro, we view food craftsmanship as a culinary symphony. We began with an unwavering dedication to serve the most succulent Levantine shawarma and golden, crunch-loaded broasted chicken.
about.paragraph2: We preserve traditional culinary secrets while introducing signature innovations like the famous 'Princess' and 'Supreme' meals and custom event celebration towers that elevate every gathering.

footer.aboutText: Maestro Restaurant - The pinnacle of artisan shawarma, crispy broasted, and gourmet subs. Dedicated to serving our community with uncompromising quality.
